title: Chapter 190: Inheritance Of Kung Fu
content:
Chapter 190: Inheritance Of Kung Fu

When a person who transfers to practice the Kung Fu method begins to practice according to the Nine Changes of Celestial Silkworm technique, Celestial Silkworm can assist the practitioner to absorb a large amount of energy from the outside world and speed up the practice.

When there are auxiliary training resources such as energy coins and luck beads to assist the training of Tiancan Nine Transformations, the absorption and utilization efficiency of its training resources will be greatly increased, and the speed of strength improvement will be even faster.

As the Celestial Silkworm itself grows, it will continue to analyze the cultivator's genes, gradually make subtle adjustments to the cultivator's genes, and change the cultivator's cultivation qualifications.

This is a very heaven-defying ability. Wu Qing will let the Queen of Insects artificially control this ability according to the identity of the practitioner. People with different identities will have completely different effects even if they also practice the Nine Transformations of Heavenly Silkworm. of.

The Celestial Silkworm and the cultivator grow together. When the cultivator's luck is sufficient, the Celestial Silkworm will absorb a certain amount of luck, undergo transformation, and advance to a higher star level together with the cultivator.

Everyone present is the one Wu Qing wants to train, and of course they can all get all the benefits of practicing the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm.

When the Celestial Silkworm entered the body, they felt the changes. Before they started practicing, the Celestial Silkworm was already helping them purify their energy.

Wu Qing was watching them on the stage. Now was not the time to practice, so everyone was reluctant to practice.

"Everyone practice well and be ready to fight at any time!"

After the matter was done, Wu Qing did not stay any longer and rode away with his bodyguard.

As expected, he came out of the current station of the Daxia Cavalry, and the lords of the alliance's territories were already waiting for him.

"Wu Qing, is there anything good going on? Don't forget the old friends in the alliance!"

Meng saw Wu Qing coming out and came to greet him.

"We all heard it. The shouts inside were loud. It must be more than just sending a war horse, right?"

Meng's mind was clear, and he also regarded the Alliance as a force under the Zerg. Seeing that the army led by Daxia had gained benefits, of course the Alliance could not just watch.

"The Lord of the Zerg has given a special skill. I just gave it to those of the same race. Everyone may have been a little excited and shouted a little loudly!"

Wu Qing smiled.

"What magical technique has been given by the Lord? It makes people so excited? Can we people practice it?"

Meng was particularly curious, and all the lords in the alliance pricked up their ears.

"The technique is quite special. You can practice it if you want. We will all go to the meeting hall to talk!"

Wu Qing took the itchy alliance lords to the meeting hall.

Everyone knows that the things given by the Zerg master will definitely not be simple.

When they arrived at the meeting hall, Wu Qing asked his bodyguard to give each lord an introduction to the Nine Transformations of the Celestial Silkworm technique. There was a distinction between closeness and distance. These lords in the alliance did not have the biological reproductive equipment of the Zerg, so they could only introduce the technique to them in this way. Law.

Even if they have Zerg biological reproduction equipment, as long as they do not completely join the Zerg system and come under the control of the Zerg, Wu Qing will not be able to pass on the biological reproduction equipment to them.

"Is there really such a powerful technique!?"

"What did the silkworm look like that day? Can you let me see it?"

Meng simply looked at the introduction materials of the exercises, and then came to ask Wu Qing for some silkworms.

Wu Qing asked his personal guard to give Meng a Celestial Silkworm. A small piece of Celestial Silkworm beeswax, placed on Meng's big hand, was almost insignificant.

Meng put his face up and looked at it carefully. The more he looked at it, the more he liked it. When the other lords couldn't help but come forward to admire it together, he swallowed the silkworm in one gulp.

"You! Are you so impatient?"

Some alliance lords said angrily.

"Hehe, the skills I practiced before were abolished, and I haven't found a suitable skill in these years!"

"I feel that the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm are particularly suitable for me! Wu Qing also said just now that we can practice if we want. Shouldn't I help you test the effect first?"

"Well, it feels really good! Kung Fu and combat skills are directly transmitted spiritually! The energy in the body begins to be purified and transformed!"

He said carelessly, took out a piece of Zerg energy coin, used the Nine Changes of Heavenly Silkworm technique and sucked it in, and a huge amount of pure energy was sucked into his body.

"Hey! This is really efficient! I feel so comfortable all over! I feel a lot refreshed!"

"Maybe it won't be long before I can become an old genius with outstanding cultivation qualifications, haha!"

Meng himself was a strong man, and he converted to the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm technique very quickly. He felt all the benefits of this technique one by one.

Wu Qing doesn’t need to say more, Meng is the best role model.

According to common sense, exercises such as the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm are meant to allow foreign objects to enter the body. Lords who have other options will not choose it casually. This involves an issue of trust.

What Meng did was to have absolute trust and unconditional support for Wu Qing.

Wu Qing had no intention of using Tiancan to test the trust of the alliance lords, nor did he blame Meng for his recklessness.

"This Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations Technique was given by the Lord. In addition to the brief introduction in the explanatory materials, more needs to be explored by the cultivators themselves!"

"The Lord's original intention is to use this technique to enhance the strength of the local camp, and will not restrict the spread of this technique. However, the Celestial Silkworm has a spirit, and depending on individual circumstances, its effect in assisting cultivation is also different!"

"I have sent people to the hinterland of the local camp to spread the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations Technique. Of course, I will not restrict the alliance's territories from practicing this technique!"

"I can give you some silkworms. You can go to your own territory to promote it and see how many people are willing to practice the Silkworm Nine Transformation Technique. I will support those who are willing to practice it, and I don't need to force those who are unwilling to practice it!"

"Inside the alliance, if you don't have enough silkworms, you can come to me to get them, but the silkworms you get can only be used in your own territory, not outside, and cannot be traded!"

"The silkworms are spiritual, it's not just talk, if you are not sincere, the silkworms will not work!"

Wu Qing said to the lords of the alliance with a smile.

The guards began to give each lord of the alliance a small bag filled with silkworms. Swallowing the silkworms will inherit the Silkworm Nine Transformation Technique. It's very simple.

"This amount is not enough! I want all the troops in the territory to switch to cultivation. I need a lot of silkworms!"

Meng opened the bag and looked at it, and then shouted.

"No problem, how many silkworms do you need, report the number, I will let the Zerg prepare!"

Wu Qing readily agreed to Meng's request.

"Haha, just report the number, that's good!"

"The army has switched to practicing the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm. It won't be long before they are all elite, hehe!"

After personal experience, Meng has the deepest understanding of the Nine Transformations of the Heavenly Silkworm. He knows that this technique must have been used by the Zerg to enhance the strength of the alliance. If he hesitates at this time, he will miss the opportunity.

Having seen the strength of the Zerg in the past few days, Meng has realized that the alliance is dispensable to the Zerg. The Zerg has given the alliance many opportunities. If it still fails to develop, it is doomed to be abandoned in the end.

Many lords of the alliance have also realized this and their mentality has changed greatly.

"This technique is indeed very suitable for soldiers to practice. I will go back to count and report the number!"

Hu Wei followed Meng closely to strive for more Heavenly Silkworms.

Shi Gan, Yu Chong and Bai Yan also expressed their opinions.

"I'll go back and do some statistics, and report the number!"

"Me too!"

"We too!"

"..."

With the five major territories of the alliance taking the lead, everyone expressed the need for more Heavenly Silkworms. Regardless of whether they themselves switch to cultivation, this positive attitude must be demonstrated.

For some alliance lords, it is most appropriate to first let the army switch to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes.

Many races have racial heritage and unique cultivation methods. Wu Qing can understand that they do not switch to the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes.

Wu Qing does not need everyone to practice the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes, but just to give those who do not have a good cultivation method a good choice.

When more people practice the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes and show all kinds of magical powers, Wu Qing believes that he does not need to say more, everyone will choose by action.

...

Wu Qing is promoting the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes internally, and the Heavenly Silkworm Knights should also promote the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Changes externally.

In the large city of the Tengu tribe where Gou Shu was, the Heavenly Silkworm Knight asked Gou Shu to rent a few large cars and brought Gou Shu and his fiancee's family to a large square in the city.

The Heavenly Silkworm Knight's promotion of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations is different from Wu Qing's internal promotion, and some strategies are needed.

Directly giving away unlimited Heavenly Silkworms to others, I guess everyone would suspect that there is something fishy.

The reputation of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations has not yet spread, and it is very difficult to promote it now. It needs to be done step by step, and there is no rush.

The first batch of Heavenly Silkworm Knights will spread some seeds, and when these seeds grow up, the conditions for the large-scale promotion of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations will be ripe.

At that time, it will not be the Heavenly Silkworm Knights who will promote it, but others will take the initiative to come to the door.

Because of the tit-for-tat with the Tengu tribe yesterday, the Heavenly Silkworm Knights have some reputation in this big city of the Tengu tribe. Many people see their insect tribe Heavenly Silkworm labels and know their identities.

The Heavenly Silkworm Knights led people through the city in a high-profile manner, attracting a lot of attention.

"Zerg Heavenly Silkworm Knight, carry the inheritance of the Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations, the divine skill bestowed by my Zerg Overlord, and travel the world, select those who are destined to inherit it!"

"My Zerg Overlord is passing on the skills to the world in order to strengthen the power of the local camp. You only need to follow the principle of 'those who inherit need to support each other and not kill each other', and you can get the inheritance for free!"

"The Heavenly Silkworm Nine Transformations is a method of parasitic cultivation of the Heavenly Silkworm. Those who have taboos are not allowed to practice it!"
